titulo: Toilet keeps running? The two-minute fix

frases.texto: Why does your toilet keep running?
A leaky one wastes about two hundred gallons a day.
If water spills down the overflow tube, the float is too high.
Turn the screw beside the float counterclockwise, until the water stops an inch below the top.
If it doesn't spill, the flapper isn't sealing. Shut the wall valve clockwise, and flush once.
Lift off the old flapper, and clip on a new one the same size.
Leave half an inch of slack in the chain, then open the valve.
The water rises and stops, and the hiss goes quiet.
Keep bleach tablets out of the tank. They warp that rubber.
If the wall valve won't turn, stop and call a plumber.
Send this to that friend whose toilet won't stop running.
